note: Appends to the chain. No earlier registry is rewritten. The Phase-7 registry (verification_tooling_registry.json) is hashed inside phase7_pretest_freeze.json as scientific evidence and can never be appended to again.

scripts/validate_phase11.py.scope: Phase-10 zero drift, manuscript freeze, no new science, claim traceability, evidence-class fidelity, hypothesis status, prohibited language, citation integrity, table and figure provenance, tooling-registry chain, Git write discipline.
scripts/validate_phase11.py.sha256_note: Deliberately null. This registry is read and checked by the very script it would pin, so a self-hash would be circular: the validator cannot verify a digest of itself that changes whenever it changes. The validator's digest is recorded instead in artifacts/v2_phase11_manifest.json, which the validator does not gate on.

scripts/verify_phase11_independently.py.purpose: Independent recomputation of the manuscript's quantitative claims through a separate parsing path.
scripts/verify_phase11_independently.py.scope: Re-derives every locked value, hypothesis wording, table value and prohibited-claim check directly from frozen artifacts without reusing validate_phase11.py code.

scripts/validate_phase8.py.purpose: Historical Phase-8 validator, frozen before the test was opened.
scripts/validate_phase8.py.scope: Referenced, not re-run as authoritative. Its two exact-HEAD git gates fail by design now that HEAD has legitimately moved past the pre-test snapshot. Source is preserved byte-for-byte as historical evidence and must never be patched.

scripts/validate_phase8_postopening.py.purpose: Current-state validator for the post-opening repository.
scripts/validate_phase8_postopening.py.scope: Uses immutable freeze-point ancestry rather than exact-HEAD equality.

scripts/validate_phase9.py.scope: Phase-9 tables, figures and analysis freeze.

scripts/validate_phase10.py.scope: Phase-10 ledgers, claim matrix, canonical conclusion and prohibited-claim enforcement on the synthesis document.
